themes.evidence: Implement agentic workflows where they add clear value (e.g., tool use, multi-step execution, human-in-the-loop controls)
Design and build advanced search, retrieval, and knowledge pipelines across diverse data structures and stores (e.g., hybrid search, vector stores, graph databases/knowledge graphs)
Build evaluation and observability for GenAI and agentic systems: tracing and instrumentation, regression test suites, automated scoring where appropriate
Translate ambiguous client needs into clear technical requirements, tradeoffs, and delivery plans.
Write clean, testable, maintainable code and ship AI services through the full SDLC: build → test → deploy → monitor → iterate.
work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption

archetype_rationale: Day-to-day is building GenAI/agentic applications while embedded with clients — 'min 3 days/week in person at client site,' 'comfort working directly with clients,' and moving solutions 'from prototype to real adoption.' That deployed-engineer-inside-consulting-teams shape is FDE, not pure platform or product-builder work.
notes: Heavier infra/MLOps bar than typical GenAI roles: Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD, PyTorch/TensorFlow training breadth are required, and secure enterprise deployment (PII handling, access controls, guardrails) is explicit — resume should surface engineering/ops evidence, not just agent builds. Band is 3-5+ years at $203,500 DC with hybrid + travel required.
